description: Operator-triggered rollback for local blue-green self-deployment. While the prior color is still inside its drain window, asks the local router to make that prior color active again. Returns rolled_back on success or rollback_not_applicable when no prior color can still be restored.
embedding_description: Rollback a local blue-green swap during the drain window. Re-points the local router back to the previous color when rollback is still possible. Takes reason and returns status, rolled_back_to, and reason. Use when a newly activated local the solet color should be abandoned before complete_swap tears down the prior color.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Rollback envelope with status, rolled_back_to, and reason.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. If rolled_back, name the active color. If rollback_not_applicable, explain that the prior color is no longer inside the drain window.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Rollback the local blue-green router to the prior color during the drain window.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: rollback_not_applicable means the prior color cannot be restored. router failures indicate local router unavailability or refusal.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Check swap_status. If rollback is no longer applicable, use restart_with_manifest or manual launch recovery instead of retrying rollback.
